question: What is reflection of light?
urdu_translation: reflection of light کیا ہے؟
A: Bending of light in a new medium / new medium میں light کا bend ہونا
B: Splitting of white light into colours / white light کا colours میں split ہونا
C: Bouncing back of light from a surface / surface سے light کا واپس bounce ہونا
D: Absorption of all light / تمام light کی absorption
correct_answer: C | Bouncing back of light from a surface / surface سے light کا واپس bounce ہونا

question: What is the relationship between angle of incidence i and angle of reflection r?
urdu_translation: angle of incidence i اور angle of reflection r میں کیا relationship ہے؟
A: i = 2r
B: r = 2i
D: i = r
correct_answer: D | i = r

question: According to the first law of reflection, which three lines lie in the same plane?
urdu_translation: first law of reflection کے مطابق کون سی three lines same plane میں ہوتی ہیں؟
A: Object, image, and mirror edge / object، image اور mirror edge
B: Focal point, lens, and screen / focal point، lens اور screen
C: Incident ray, reflected ray, and normal / incident ray، reflected ray اور normal
D: Crest, trough, and wavefront / crest، trough اور wavefront
correct_answer: C | Incident ray, reflected ray, and normal / incident ray، reflected ray اور normal

question: Which reflection occurs from a smooth polished surface?
urdu_translation: smooth polished surface سے کون سی reflection occur کرتی ہے؟
A: Diffuse reflection / diffuse reflection
B: Regular or specular reflection / regular یا specular reflection
C: Total internal reflection / total internal reflection
D: Refraction / refraction
correct_answer: B | Regular or specular reflection / regular یا specular reflection

question: Why is no clear image formed by a rough surface?
urdu_translation: rough surface سے clear image کیوں نہیں بنتی؟
A: All rays obey no law / تمام rays کوئی law obey نہیں کرتیں
B: Light speed becomes zero / light speed zero ہو جاتی ہے
C: The surface emits ultrasound / surface ultrasound emit کرتی ہے
D: Reflected rays scatter in different directions / reflected rays different directions میں scatter کرتی ہیں
correct_answer: D | Reflected rays scatter in different directions / reflected rays different directions میں scatter کرتی ہیں

question: Which property is true for an image in a plane mirror?
urdu_translation: plane mirror image کی کون سی property true ہے؟
A: It is always real and inverted / یہ ہمیشہ real اور inverted ہوتی ہے
B: It is smaller than the object / یہ object سے smaller ہوتی ہے
C: It is virtual and erect / یہ virtual اور erect ہوتی ہے
D: It can always be caught on a screen / یہ ہمیشہ screen پر catch ہو سکتی ہے
correct_answer: C | It is virtual and erect / یہ virtual اور erect ہوتی ہے

question: How does image distance compare with object distance in a plane mirror?
urdu_translation: plane mirror میں image distance اور object distance کا کیا comparison ہے؟
A: Image distance is double / image distance double ہے
B: Object distance is zero / object distance zero ہے
C: They are unrelated / وہ unrelated ہیں
D: They are equal / وہ equal ہیں
correct_answer: D | They are equal / وہ equal ہیں

question: What is lateral inversion?
urdu_translation: lateral inversion کیا ہے؟
A: Turning an image upside down / image کو upside down کرنا
B: Interchange of left and right in a mirror image / mirror image میں left اور right کا interchange
C: Changing a real image into light / real image کو light میں change کرنا
D: Increasing image size / image size increase کرنا
correct_answer: B | Interchange of left and right in a mirror image / mirror image میں left اور right کا interchange

question: What is refraction of light?
urdu_translation: refraction of light کیا ہے؟
A: Bouncing back from the same surface / same surface سے bounce back
B: Production of charge by rubbing / rubbing سے charge production
C: Spreading of sound around corners / sound کا corners کے around spread ہونا
D: Change in direction when light speed changes between media / media کے درمیان light speed change ہونے سے direction change
correct_answer: D | Change in direction when light speed changes between media / media کے درمیان light speed change ہونے سے direction change

question: A ray entering a denser medium and slowing down bends:
urdu_translation: denser medium میں enter ہو کر slow ہونے والی ray کس طرف bend کرتی ہے؟
A: Away from the normal / normal سے away
B: Along the surface only / صرف surface کے along
C: Towards the normal / normal کی طرف
D: Back to the source always / ہمیشہ source کی طرف back
correct_answer: C | Towards the normal / normal کی طرف

question: A ray entering a rarer medium and speeding up bends:
urdu_translation: rarer medium میں enter ہو کر speed up ہونے والی ray کس طرف bend کرتی ہے؟
A: Away from the normal / normal سے away
B: Towards the normal / normal کی طرف
C: Without any direction / without direction
D: Into a circle / circle میں
correct_answer: A | Away from the normal / normal سے away

question: Which formula defines refractive index in terms of speeds?
urdu_translation: speeds کے terms میں refractive index کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: n = v/c
B: n = cv
C: n = c + v
D: n = c/v
correct_answer: D | n = c/v

question: Which relation represents Snell's law for light entering a medium from air?
urdu_translation: air سے medium میں light enter ہونے پر Snell's law کا relation کون سا ہے؟
A: n = sin r/sin i
B: n = i/r
C: n = sin i/sin r
D: n = i + r
correct_answer: C | n = sin i/sin r

question: If n = 1.5 and c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, what is the speed of light in the medium?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل medium میں light speed معلوم کریں: n = 1.5, c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s
correct_answer: A | 2 × 10⁸ m/s

question: What is the angle between the original direction and emergent ray from a prism called?
urdu_translation: prism سے original direction اور emergent ray کے درمیان angle کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
A: Critical angle / critical angle
B: Angle of reflection / angle of reflection
C: Angle of deviation / angle of deviation
D: Focal angle / focal angle
correct_answer: C | Angle of deviation / angle of deviation

question: What is the critical angle?
urdu_translation: critical angle کیا ہے؟
A: Angle of incidence for which angle of refraction is 90° / angle of incidence جس پر angle of refraction 90° ہو
B: Angle of reflection equal to zero / angle of reflection zero ہو
C: Angle between lens and axis / lens اور axis کا angle
D: Angle at which light stops moving / angle جس پر light stop ہو
correct_answer: A | Angle of incidence for which angle of refraction is 90° / angle of incidence جس پر angle of refraction 90° ہو

question: For total internal reflection, light must travel from:
urdu_translation: total internal reflection کے لیے light کس medium سے کس medium کی طرف travel کرتی ہے؟
A: Denser medium to rarer medium / denser medium سے rarer medium
B: Rarer medium to denser medium / rarer medium سے denser medium
C: Vacuum to vacuum only / صرف vacuum سے vacuum
D: Any medium at zero incidence / any medium at zero incidence
correct_answer: A | Denser medium to rarer medium / denser medium سے rarer medium

question: What second condition is required for total internal reflection?
urdu_translation: total internal reflection کے لیے second condition کیا ہے؟
A: Angle of incidence must be zero / angle of incidence zero ہو
B: Angle of refraction must be less than incidence in every case / ہر case میں refraction angle less ہو
C: Light must be sound / light sound ہو
D: Angle of incidence must exceed the critical angle / angle of incidence critical angle سے greater ہو
correct_answer: D | Angle of incidence must exceed the critical angle / angle of incidence critical angle سے greater ہو

question: When the second medium is air, which relation connects refractive index and critical angle?
urdu_translation: second medium air ہو تو refractive index اور critical angle کا relation کون سا ہے؟
A: n = 1/sin C
B: n = sin C
C: n = cos C
correct_answer: A | n = 1/sin C

question: A material has critical angle 30° in air. What is its refractive index?
urdu_translation: air میں critical angle 30° والے material کا refractive index معلوم کریں۔

question: Which principle guides light through an optical fibre?
urdu_translation: optical fibre میں light کو guide کرنے والا principle کون سا ہے؟
A: Diffuse reflection / diffuse reflection
B: Total internal reflection / total internal reflection
C: Conduction / conduction
D: Electromagnetic induction / electromagnetic induction
correct_answer: B | Total internal reflection / total internal reflection

question: Which is an advantage of optical fibres over copper cables?
urdu_translation: copper cables کے مقابلے میں optical fibres کا advantage کون سا ہے؟
A: High bandwidth and resistance to electrical interference / high bandwidth اور electrical interference سے resistance
B: They require more power and lose more signal / وہ more power require اور more signal lose کرتی ہیں
C: They carry data only over short distances / وہ data صرف short distances پر carry کرتی ہیں
D: They use moving charges as the signal inside glass / وہ glass کے اندر moving charges کو signal بناتی ہیں
correct_answer: A | High bandwidth and resistance to electrical interference / high bandwidth اور electrical interference سے resistance

question: Which lens is thicker at the centre and thinner at the edges?
urdu_translation: کون سا lens centre پر thicker اور edges پر thinner ہوتا ہے؟
A: Concave or diverging lens / concave یا diverging lens
B: Convex or converging lens / convex یا converging lens
C: Plane mirror / plane mirror
D: Prism only / صرف prism
correct_answer: B | Convex or converging lens / convex یا converging lens

question: Which lens is thinner at the centre and thicker at the edges?
urdu_translation: کون سا lens centre پر thinner اور edges پر thicker ہوتا ہے؟
A: Convex or converging lens / convex یا converging lens
B: Plane glass plate / plane glass plate
C: Concave or diverging lens / concave یا diverging lens
D: Optical fibre / optical fibre
correct_answer: C | Concave or diverging lens / concave یا diverging lens

question: What is the principal axis of a lens?
urdu_translation: lens کی principal axis کیا ہے؟
A: Any curved line through the edge / edge سے گزرنے والی any curved line
B: Line joining object to screen only / صرف object کو screen سے join کرنے والی line
C: Straight line through the optical centre / optical centre سے گزرنے والی straight line
D: Normal to a mirror only / صرف mirror کا normal
correct_answer: C | Straight line through the optical centre / optical centre سے گزرنے والی straight line

question: What is focal length?
urdu_translation: focal length کیا ہے؟
A: Diameter of the lens / lens کا diameter
B: Distance from optical centre to principal focus / optical centre سے principal focus تک distance
C: Distance between object and screen only / صرف object اور screen کے درمیان distance
D: Thickness at the edge / edge پر thickness
correct_answer: B | Distance from optical centre to principal focus / optical centre سے principal focus تک distance

question: Which formula gives lens power?
urdu_translation: lens power کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: P = f
B: P = f²
C: P = 1/f²
D: P = 1/f
correct_answer: D | P = 1/f

question: What is the SI unit of lens power?
urdu_translation: lens power کی SI unit کیا ہے؟
A: Metre per second / metre per second
B: Hertz / hertz
C: Dioptre (D) / dioptre (D)
D: Joule / joule
correct_answer: C | Dioptre (D) / dioptre (D)

question: A concave lens has f = −0.25 m. What is its power?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل concave lens کی power معلوم کریں: f = −0.25 m
correct_answer: D | −4 D

question: A convex lens forms a virtual enlarged image when the object is placed:
urdu_translation: convex lens virtual enlarged image کب form کرتا ہے؟
A: Beyond 2F only / صرف beyond 2F
B: Between the lens and focal point F / lens اور focal point F کے درمیان
C: At infinity only / صرف infinity پر
D: Exactly at 2F only / صرف exactly 2F پر
correct_answer: B | Between the lens and focal point F / lens اور focal point F کے درمیان

question: Which image can be projected on a screen?
urdu_translation: کون سی image screen پر project کی جا سکتی ہے؟
A: Virtual image / virtual image
B: Real image / real image
C: Laterally inverted plane-mirror image / plane-mirror کی laterally inverted image
D: Apparent focus / apparent focus
correct_answer: B | Real image / real image

question: When an object is at 2F of a convex lens, the image is:
urdu_translation: convex lens میں object 2F پر ہو تو image کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: At 2F, same size, real and inverted / 2F پر، same size، real اور inverted
B: At F, enlarged and virtual / F پر، enlarged اور virtual
C: At infinity, diminished / infinity پر، diminished
D: Between lens and F, erect and smaller / lens اور F کے درمیان، erect اور smaller
correct_answer: A | At 2F, same size, real and inverted / 2F پر، same size، real اور inverted

question: Which formula gives linear magnification?
urdu_translation: linear magnification کا formula کون سا ہے؟
A: M = h₀/hᵢ
B: M = hᵢ + h₀
C: M = f/h₀
D: M = hᵢ/h₀
correct_answer: D | M = hᵢ/h₀

question: An object is 8 cm high and M = −2. What is image height?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل image height معلوم کریں: h₀ = 8 cm, M = −2
A: −16 cm
B: +16 cm
C: −4 cm
D: +4 cm
correct_answer: A | −16 cm

question: Which lens is used as a magnifying glass?
urdu_translation: magnifying glass میں کون سا lens use ہوتا ہے؟
A: Concave lens / concave lens
B: Plane mirror only / صرف plane mirror
C: Convex lens / convex lens
D: Prism only / صرف prism
correct_answer: C | Convex lens / convex lens

question: Which lens corrects short-sightedness?
urdu_translation: short-sightedness کو کون سا lens correct کرتا ہے؟
A: Diverging concave lens / diverging concave lens
B: Converging convex lens / converging convex lens
C: Plane glass plate / plane glass plate
D: No optical element / no optical element
correct_answer: A | Diverging concave lens / diverging concave lens

question: Which lens corrects long-sightedness?
urdu_translation: long-sightedness کو کون سا lens correct کرتا ہے؟
A: Diverging concave lens / diverging concave lens
B: Plane mirror / plane mirror
C: Optical fibre / optical fibre
D: Converging convex lens / converging convex lens
correct_answer: D | Converging convex lens / converging convex lens

question: What is dispersion of light?
urdu_translation: dispersion of light کیا ہے؟
A: Reflection of all colours together / تمام colours کی together reflection
B: Separation of white light into its component colours / white light کا component colours میں separation
C: Conversion of light into sound / light کو sound میں conversion
D: Absorption by a black surface / black surface سے absorption
correct_answer: B | Separation of white light into its component colours / white light کا component colours میں separation

question: What is gravitational lensing?
urdu_translation: gravitational lensing کیا ہے؟
A: Bending of sound by temperature / temperature سے sound bending
B: Bending of light by strong gravity from massive objects / massive objects کی strong gravity سے light bending
C: Reflection from a plane mirror / plane mirror سے reflection
D: Splitting charge by induction / induction سے charge splitting
correct_answer: B | Bending of light by strong gravity from massive objects / massive objects کی strong gravity سے light bending

question: Why can a thermometer detect radiation beyond the red end of a visible spectrum?
urdu_translation: visible spectrum کے red end سے beyond radiation کو thermometer کیوں detect کر سکتا ہے؟
A: Ultraviolet radiation is always cold / ultraviolet radiation ہمیشہ cold ہوتی ہے
B: Infrared radiation produces a heating effect / infrared radiation heating effect produce کرتی ہے
C: Sound waves form beyond red / red سے beyond sound waves form ہوتی ہیں
D: No energy exists beyond red / red سے beyond کوئی energy نہیں ہوتی
correct_answer: B | Infrared radiation produces a heating effect / infrared radiation heating effect produce کرتی ہے
